The league is governed by the [[Danish Football Association]] (DBU). The 1st Division changed its name to the '''BetiniaLiga''' after [[NordicBet]]'s sponsorship ended in [[2024–25 Danish 2nd Division|2024–25]].{{Cite web |title=Divisionsforeningen og Soft2Bet indgår historisk aftale: Nye navne til de danske divisioner {{!}} News {{!}} Soft2Bet |url=https://www.soft2bet.com/news/divisionsforeningen-og-soft2bet-indgar-historisk-aftale-nye-navne-til-de-danske-divisioner |access-date=9 July 2025 |website=www.soft2bet.com |language=en}} ==Participants== [[FC Fredericia]] and [[Vejle Boldklub|Vejle]] finished the [[2025–26 Danish Superliga|2025–26 season of the Superliga]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the 1st Division. They replaced [[Lyngby Boldklub|Lyngby]] and [[AC Horsens]], who were promoted to the [[2026–27 Danish Superliga]]. [[Akademisk Boldklub|AB]] and [[Vendsyssel FF]] won promotion from the [[2025–26 Danish 2nd Division]]. They replaced [[Boldklubben af 1893|B.93]] and [[Middelfart G&BK]] who were relegated to the [[2026–27 Danish 2nd Division]]. === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Denmark |float=right |width=400 |caption=Locations of the 2025–26 Danish 1st Division teams.
